Question
========
What is overfitting?

Answerlist
----------
* model too complex
* model fits noise instead of real patterns
* model so general that it fits any data
* model that perfectly fits the data


Solution
========
Overfitting means a model fits noise instead of real patterns.

----------
* False

* False
